initial_worktree: Clean at bf21ebc; VP3 wiring, separate-definition generator, team SpringPunch update and one-host test GameMode committed.
implementation: Opt-in LaunchRebound visual channel in the existing component/config/frame/AnimInstance; existing ChassisRotation AnimGraph output reused, no new Tick/module/plugin.
Finite cubic rise/return envelope with configured amplitude and durations; negative amplitude supported through existing calibrated pitch axis/sign.
Client observes one controlled ball and predicts at the actual launch input edge; authority alone accepts the launch under unchanged gameplay rules.
LaunchSequence plus authority game timestamp: unreliable accepted multicast for current observers, existing reliable owner result extended with timestamp for confirmation/rejection.
Matching prediction confirmation preserves age and does not restart; rejection fades current amplitude, observers compensate event age, duplicate/out-of-order/expired events ignored.
At most 8 concurrent pulses, sequence watermark preserved across ordinary resets, local reset timestamp rejects earlier-binding events; no historical replay for late join.
Driving pitch filter retained, its contribution blends out at shot peak to prevent braking lean cancelling launch feedback; shared pitch/roll composition limits.
Existing actual recoil, ball state/launch force, combat/GAS, movement effects and network-physics history unchanged; no second physical impulse.
hal.VehicleLaunchVisualLog defaults off; logs event identities/consumption, no per-frame logging.
